hero.title: Classes & Curriculum
hero.subtitle: Inspiring hands-on activities that ignite a lifelong passion for discovery.

sections.title: Experiential Learning Across Every Discipline
sections.subtitle: Blending STEAM inquiry, creative arts, and gross motor play.
sections.content:
Our curriculum modules are engineered around five core developmental pillars: **Sensory Arts**, **Phonics & Language Mastery**, **Musical Movement**, **STEAM Discovery**, and **Social-Emotional Life Skills**.

Every day combines joyful active exploration in specialized learning zones under the guidance of certified child development mentors.

sections.title: Key Developmental Modules
sections.subtitle: Comprehensive activity stations rotating through every school day.

cards.title: Arts, Crafts & Sensory Clay
cards.description: Tactile molding, watercolor washes, paper collage, and finger painting.

cards.title: Phonics & Storytelling Circles
cards.description: Letter sound recognition, puppet shows, rhyme games, and vocabulary expansion.

cards.title: Little STEAM Investigators
cards.description: Magnet sets, water wheel channels, balance scales, and nature specimen magnifying.

cards.title: Music, Rhythm & Gymnastics
cards.description: Percussion instruments, tempo clapping, obstacle tracks, and balance beams.

sections.title: Explore Our Classrooms in Person
sections.description: Book a campus tour and watch our interactive class modules in action.
